column4: 'Vowel letter' duplicates the 'vowel' meaning, which is the same sense of klinker.
Mineur (military engineer) is essentially the same meaning as the existing 'sapper', so it duplicates it.
Program is the same software meaning as application, so it duplicates entry 3.
Premature is essentially the same as the "early" sense and the example is stilted, so it duplicates another meaning.
Gieterij means foundry; 'act of pouring' is not a real meaning and the foundry meaning is already listed.
Aars means anus, and 'shit' is not a real meaning of it; the other meanings already cover anus and butt.
Female bird is an obscure, doubtful sense of gaai; the main meaning (jay) is listed elsewhere.
Female fish is an obscure, doubtful sense of gaai that only confuses learners.
Gaai as 'human mistress' is not a real meaning and is obscure at best, so it only confuses a learner.
'Wooden' is not a noun meaning of gaai and is a nonsensical gloss; the high wooden stake meaning is already listed.
Belezen does not mean "to convince"; the verb has a meaning like "to exorcise" (bezweren) or "to read" at most, and this example is invented.
Archaic sense of 'timmer' as the act of building duplicates the 'construction work' and 'building' meanings and only confuses learners.
Archaic 'room' sense of 'timmer' is obscure and would confuse learners, and it overlaps with the building-related meanings.
The fox moth sense is obscure and is not a normal meaning of veelvraat; the word is a glutton or wolverine, and the moth is more usually called a different name.
Serene is essentially the same as the other meaning 'calm', so this duplicates it.
Serenely and calmly are near-synonyms for the same adverbial use, so this meaning duplicates the other one.
The gloss is a fragment and the meaning duplicates the other meaning 'caste'.
This is a near duplicate of the 'supposed' meaning, which already covers vermeend.
'verslijten voor' meaning 'to take for' is not real Dutch usage (that would be 'aanzien voor'); verslijten only means to wear out, which is already listed.
Presentatrice does not mean bearer of a cheque (that is presentator/presenteerder), and article 'de' is correct.
Vague 'name of various vines' is just a variant of the tendril meaning and is confusing, so it is dropped.
'Pleasant region' is not a real meaning of prieel; the arbor meaning covers it.
'Citrus' is not normally used for juice in Dutch (that is citrussap), so this meaning is not real and is rare.
The non-believer sense is a dated, offensive slur that mostly confuses learners, and the example is not natural usage, so drop it.
The Latin name Aconitum napellus duplicates the aconite meaning and is not a separate sense.
The gloss 'government building of a village' duplicates the other meaning, village meetinghouse, which is the real sense of dorpshuis.
The lesser chinchilla is just a species of chinchilla and duplicates the first meaning, which is not useful to a learner.
'Bees' as candy is not a real meaning; 'bes' is berry and 'bees' is a colloquial or child-language word for a kiss, and candy is invented.
The meaning 'something important' is rare and dubious for belangrijkheid and mostly duplicates 'importance'.
'Something perverse' (a perverse act) largely duplicates the perversion meaning, so one entry suffices.
'See kroonjuwelen' is a cross-reference, not a meaning, and the other senses are covered.
specifically is a fragment of the definition of bul (papal bull), not a real meaning, and the charter sense is already listed.
Trinket is not a real meaning of bul and is obscure or unsupported, so it only confuses learners.
It duplicates the other meaning, which is essentially the same sense of bravura.
A 'nickname' sense merely duplicates the other roetmop entry, which covers the same offensive term, and is not a distinct meaning.
Woesteling does not mean devastation (that would be woestenij or verwoesting), so this meaning does not exist.
Archaic and obscure, and 'second teacher' is dubious; a learner would only be confused, and it overlaps with the other meaning (second).
Casus does not mean coincidence in Dutch; it means case (legal or grammatical), which are already listed.
The 'small' gloss is a bad archaic sense (a type of coat/jacket) that only confuses learners and has no example.
cool as a noun duplicates the coolness meaning, so this entry just repeats another one.
to not sleep during is the same meaning as the existing "to pull an all-nighter" entry, so it duplicates it.
'Plump' is not a meaning of loef; it is a wrong gloss, and the real meaning is covered by the windward side entry.
Stijfsel is starch used as a stiffener, so this vague 'additive' meaning duplicates the other meaning and the sauce example is dubious.
This verb sense is not a real, common Dutch usage and the gloss is nonsensical; it only confuses learners.
Sprokkelen means gathering firewood or collecting bit by bit, not cheating; this meaning does not exist.
Inboorling means native; 'region' is wrong and the real meaning is already listed.
'To pretty up' essentially duplicates 'to dress up', both covering smartening up something or someone.
'To strike (e.g. with poverty)' is not a real meaning of choqueren; it means to shock or offend, which is already listed.
'Deeply' duplicates the 'head over heels' meaning (sense 5), where the same usage with verliefd is covered.
The Canadian township sense is a marginal regional meaning that confuses learners, and the entry already has the judicial district and canton senses.
'Making a formula' is a verb-style gloss that duplicates the formulation meanings and is not a distinct noun sense.
'To disperse' duplicates the existing meaning 'to slowly disperse'.
's is not an article meaning D-flat; 'des' is a musical note, not this word, so the meaning is bogus.
The 'provider' sense is archaic and obscure, and the entry duplicates the other aanbrenger meanings, so it only confuses learners.
'aandurven' means 'to dare'; 'to toe the line' is not a meaning and the other meaning already covers it.
It only repeats the meaning 'plausibility', and the gloss 'something that is plausible' is not a real separate sense.
'Approachable' is not a real meaning of aanraakbaar (that would be 'toegankelijk'); the word only means touchable, which is listed separately.
Archaic and duplicates the other meaning 'to accuse', with an awkward example that only confuses learners.
The obstruct sense is archaic and unattested, and it only confuses a learner.
Archaic nominalized infinitive; "existence" and "presence" are near-duplicates, so keep only one entry.
Near duplicate of the 'traceable' meaning of achterhaalbaar; 'verifiable' is not really the meaning.
Achternoen means afternoon, not lunch; this meaning does not exist and the afternoon sense is kept in item 3.
Het achterplan means the background, and 'backstage' is not a standard meaning, so this meaning is a duplicate or a misreading of the 'background' sense.
'Achterzeilen' is not an established Dutch verb; the example sense 'to outpace' is invented and 'not participate' is also wrong.
'Malay' is not a meaning of adat, only its language of origin, and the real meaning is covered by the other entry.
'Elevate' is essentially the same figurative sense as 'to ennoble', so it duplicates the other meaning.
Boa and boa constrictor are the same meaning of afgodslang, so this duplicates item 2.
To shake is not a meaning of afknijpen; the informal sense (to pinch off, squeeze) is already covered by the other meanings, so this one is spurious.
The meaning 'to measure' is a questionable, obscure archaic sense that is not well attested for afmikken and would only confuse a learner.
Archaic Latin-like 'Africanus' is obscure and duplicates the other meanings Afrikaner and African.
'To economise' is not a meaning of afromen; it is wrong and the real meanings are already listed.
